note: Nebraska Game and Parks SRA on 2,068-acre Johnson Lake, about 10 mi south of Lexington; the lake is otherwise ringed by private cabins. Two campgrounds about 3.7 km apart: Main on the southeast shore (shady, gravel pads, near the showers and the sandy swim beach) and Inlet on the west side by the inlet canal (boat ramp, bank fishing, accessible pier), with Inlet's sites along the shore. Park entry permit required. --Claude
